title: 2021 Fall AMC 10B Problem 4
statement: At noon on a certain day, Minneapolis is \(N\) degrees warmer than St. Louis. At \(4{:}00\) the temperature in Minneapolis has fallen by \(5\) degrees while the temperature in St. Louis has risen by \(3\) degrees, at which time the temperatures in the two cities differ by \(2\) degrees. What is the product of all possible values of \(N?\)

solutions.text:
Let \(N=m-s\) be the noon temperature difference. At \(4{:}00,\) the new difference is \((m-5)-(s+3)=N-8.\)

The temperatures then differ by \(2\) degrees, so \(|N-8|=2.\) Hence \(N=6\) or \(N=10,\) and the product of all possible values is \(6\cdot10=60.\)

Thus, the answer is C .
hints: After the temperature changes, the difference is \(|N-8|\)
